title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 BackendURL WebSocket Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 devices. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of log files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the charx-oa account.
addtionnal_details: Fixed in firmware v1.9.1, available by Aug 12, 2026.https://certvde.com/en/advisories/VDE-2026-008/
